decision_rule: The release gate passes only when the complete paired 95% confidence interval for the signed difference in Synthetic XI championship probability between neutral home and neutral away orientations is contained within [-0.04, +0.04], using at least 2000 paired observations.
smoke_policy: The 200-pair smoke result is diagnostic only. It may detect gross asymmetry but cannot authorize orientation equivalence, even when its point estimate lies inside the equivalence margin.
